WITH expense_totals AS (
  SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) as total_cost, COUNT(*) as expense_count
  FROM expense
  GROUP BY link_to_budget
),
budget_with_totals AS (
  SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(et.total_cost, 0) as line_total, COALESCE(et.expense_count, 0) as line_expense_count
  FROM budget b
  LEFT JOIN expense_totals et ON b.budget_id = et.link_to_budget
),
average_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(line_total) as avg_total FROM budget_with_totals
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT bwt.line_total, bwt.line_expense_count, at.avg_total
  FROM budget_with_totals bwt
  CROSS JOIN average_total at
  WHERE bwt.line_total > at.avg_total
)
SELECT AVG(line_total) as average_of_above_average_totals, SUM(line_expense_count) as total_expenses_count, AVG(line_total - avg_total) as average_excess
FROM above_average;
